name.fr-FR: L’Année liturgique : la Passion et la Semaine sainte
name.en-US: The Liturgical Year: Passiontide and Holy Week
name.pt-BR: O Ano Litúrgico: a Paixão e a Semana Santa

description.fr-FR: Sixième volume de l’Année liturgique : le temps de la Passion et la Semaine sainte, du dimanche de la Passion au samedi saint, avec le Triduum sacré en entier.
description.en-US: Volume 6 of the 15-volume Liturgical Year (L’Année liturgique) in the original French: Passiontide and Holy Week. One chapter per day or feast, with the liturgical texts in Latin and French as the edition prints them.
description.pt-BR: Volume 6 dos 15 volumes de «O Ano Litúrgico» (L’Année liturgique) em francês: a Paixão e a Semana Santa. Um capítulo por dia ou festa, com os textos litúrgicos em latim e francês como a edição os imprime.

fr-FR.editor: Dom Prosper Guéranger, abbé de Solesmes (14th ed., Oudin)

sources.description: Dom Guéranger site (Societas pro canonizatione D. Guéranger), WordPress text of the 14th edition (1900). Split at each day or feast heading; verse kept as hard line breaks; footnotes renumbered per chapter.
sources.tierEvidence: Guéranger died in 1875; the text is the 19th-century edition transcribed.
